The applied-for-ITIN reading was not exercised by the sample. Project stands.

The project accepts person.tin or person.work_ssn for each person. An SSN valid for employment issued before the due date (person.work_ssn) is an SSN issued by then, so on consistent answers work_ssn yes implies tin yes and the two tests agree. Project yes, candidate no. Off completed returns: 16 value of the same contradiction on refused returns (classm.otjob.2, classm.sc.3, classm.ssb.2, classm.tcw.8, .10, .11; generated 45, 47, 98, 99, 106, 157, 425, 428, 470, 480). rulings.ruling: Ruling: finding; p501 p. 9, Death or birth: "To qualify you for head of household filing status, the qualifying person ... must be one of the following. • Your qualifying child or qualifying relative who lived with you for more than half the part of the year they were alive. • Your parent for whom you paid, for the entire part of the year your parent was alive, more than half the cost of keeping up the home your parent lived in" (i1040gi p. 15 sends the case there: "If the person is anyone else, see Pub. 501"). The candidate composed the project's own dependent.hoh_test1 and dependent.hoh_test2, so its review never tested them (the BUG-0146 gap); checked here against i1040gi p. 14 Tests 1 and 2 and p501 Table 4, they are right for persons alive all year, but their inputs default the death case: dependent.months tells the filer, for any non-qualifying-child person who died in 2025, to "enter 12 only if your home was their home for the entire time they were alive ... and 0 otherwise", and dependent.parent_home_paid asks about the parent's main home "for all of 2025". Witness (constructed from fixture stage8.hoh.parent.test1, evaluated by the engine): a dependent parent who died in 2025 after living with the filer for more than half but not all of her lifetime that year, filer paying over half the home cost (home_cost true, months 0 as instructed, parent_home_paid false): project household.hoh_fails true and Form 1040 line 12e refused ('Head of household is checked but the tests are not met'); Pub. 501 makes her a qualifying person, and with months 7 the same return computes line 12e $23,625.00. Triage executable-triage-v1 (triage/household.json): 1,782 of 1,783 agree; the one difference (project-refuses, audit.household.hoh_community_property) is the owner's choice amb.2025.hoh_community_property (i1040gi p. 23, Community Property States) and is ambiguity on its own.
